articles.title: Alec Benjamin、内省的な新曲リリース
articles.excerpt: Alec Benjaminが2026年11月13日(金)にニューシングル「Without My Strings」をリリースした。 本作は、他者からの期待や、自分自身で作り上げてしまった限界、そして人生を思い通りに生きられなくさせる様々な状況から抜け出し、自分自身の人生の主導権を取り戻すことをテーマにした楽曲。感情豊かなボーカルと、内省的なメッセージが融合した、希望と解放を感じさせるポップナンバーに仕上がっている。 本楽曲のプロデュースには、Sacha Skarbek、Stephen Barnes、Yarden“JORDi”Pelegが参加。アコースティックな温もりとピアノ、ストリングスによる豊かな音楽的広がりが、楽曲の持つ解放感と感情の起伏を引き立てている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.j…
articles.translatedTitle: Alec Benjamin releases introspective new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alec Benjamin released his new single "Without My Strings" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This song is about getting rid of the expectations of others, the limits you have created for yourself, and the various situations that prevent you from living your life the way you want, and regaining control of your own life. The song is a pop number that combines emotional vocals and an introspective message, giving a feeling of hope and liberation. This song was produced by Sacha Skarbek, Stephen Barnes, and Yarden “JORDi” Peleg. The rich musical expanse of the acoustic warmth, piano, and strings brings out the sense of freedom and emotional ups and downs of the song. Release information https://ototoy.j…

articles.title: Amira Elfeky、夢と現実が交差する新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Amira Elfekyが2026年11月13日(金)にニューアルバム『It was only a dream』をリリースした。 本作は、2025年発表のEP『Surrender』に続く作品であり、彼女にとって初のフルアルバム。これまで培ってきた重厚なオルタナティブロックやニューメタルのサウンドを基盤に、ポップやエレクトロニックの要素を大胆に取り入れ、アーティストとしての新たな表現領域を切り拓く意欲作となっている。 本作の中心にあるテーマは、理想の自分と現実の自分との間に存在するギャップ、そして自己解放への渇望。夢の中にいる自分と現実を生きる自分が衝突し、やがて一つになっていくというコンセプトが、音楽とアートワークの両面から表現されている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/defau…
articles.translatedTitle: Amira Elfeky, new AL release where dreams and reality intersect
articles.translatedExcerpt: Amira Elfeky released her new album "It was only a dream" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This work is the follow-up to the EP "Surrender" released in 2025, and is her first full-length album. Based on the solid alternative rock and nu metal sounds that he has cultivated up until now, this album boldly incorporates pop and electronic elements, creating an ambitious work that opens up a new realm of expression for him as an artist. The central theme of this work is the gap between the ideal self and the real self, and the longing for self-liberation. The concept of the self in a dream and the self living in reality colliding and eventually becoming one is expressed through both music and artwork. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/defau…

articles.title: Emma Ogier、全12曲を収録した新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Emma Ogierが2026年11月11日(水)にニューアルバム『Fly 1111』をリリースした。 本作には、音楽とともに生きることの喜びや犠牲、将来への迷い、そして不確かな状況の中でも自分自身を信じることの大切さを描いた全12曲を収録。プロデューサーにDavid Baronを迎え、彼女の豊かな創造性と飾らない人間性を凝縮した作品に仕上がっている。 本作の中心にあるテーマは、クリエイティブな人生を選択することに伴う犠牲と葛藤、そして自分の直感を信じること。恋愛の高揚感や人間関係の複雑さ、成長することへの戸惑いなど、誰もが経験し得る感情を率直な言葉で表現している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4421376 アーティスト情報 https://www.inst…
articles.translatedTitle: Emma Ogier releases new AL with 12 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Emma Ogier released her new album ``Fly 1111'' on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. This work includes a total of 12 songs that depict the joy and sacrifice of living with music, doubts about the future, and the importance of believing in yourself even in uncertain situations. With David Baron as the producer, the result is a work that condenses her rich creativity and simple humanity. The film's central themes are the sacrifices and conflicts that come with choosing a creative life, and trusting one's intuition. It uses frank words to express emotions that anyone can experience, such as the exhilaration of love, the complexity of human relationships, and the confusion of growing up. articles.translatedExcerpt: Reina Washio, who celebrated her 15th anniversary since her debut this year, released her new song ``Miharashi'' today, November 13th (Friday). Since his debut in 2011, Washio has been active as a member of Flower and E-girls, and currently works as a solo artist. This work was written and composed by singer-songwriter Jaku Nakajima, and is a song that depicts the future that extends beyond the steps taken so far and the possibilities for oneself. articles.translatedTitle: [Interview] Is this a miracle or is it natural? The mysterious "violin guitar"
articles.translatedExcerpt: In 2026, the season for TC Musical Instruments' famous "Modified Guitar Contest" has arrived. This event, which is held every year in alternation with the "Modified Effector Contest," is in its 6th year. The number of applicants has been increasing year by year, and this year's collection was the largest ever. Although it has a simple name, ``Modified Guitar Contest,'' the rules are loosely based on the concept that ``having fun is the most important thing,'' and it is one of the events that has become a tradition in the musical instrument industry, with everyone from the creators and judges to the guitar enthusiasts who see these works laughing, surprised, admiring, complimenting them by saying ``You're stupid,'' and giving them the utmost respect by saying ``You're crazy.'' Many of the guitars submitted this time were rare and rare pieces, and it was hard to tell whether they were a joke or a joke, or whether they were being taken for granted. If you think it's a joke, it actually makes sense...

The music video for "Destiny Search" was directed by filmmaker Ayaka Masuda and starred Shuhei Nomura and Yui Narumi. A man and a woman meet by chance on a ferry, and the glances, expressions, and casual gestures they exchange on the boat are depicted, and the sense of distance between the two, who gradually become attracted to each other, is delicately expressed. articles.translatedTitle: Kanpekina Hoshi releases new song “Watchi”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kanpekina Hoshi, a three-person band based in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, digitally released their new single "Watchi" on November 11th (Wednesday). Kanpekina Hoshi is a three-person band whose lyrics and compositions are written by Gt./Vo. Reimi Okabe, and whose sound is a cross between the lyricism of folk and the fluctuations of shoegaze. Through Japanese lyrics that describe everyday emotions and love, and delicate melodies and tones, they create a unique world of music. The new song "Watchi" is a song that depicts love for one's family and the pain and loneliness that arises within that relationship. The song expresses the family relationship where love and hate, happiness and unhappiness exist side by side, using bright and airy sounds. The song is a song that describes the joys, conflicts, and sometimes conflicting emotions that come from connecting with family in frank words, and depicts the feelings of beings who leave a mark on one's life, for better or for worse.

articles.excerpt: JINGRANGが2026年11月11日(水)に初のオリジナルアルバム『EnYu』をリリースした。 本作は、ジャンルの境界にとらわれない豊かな音楽的語彙と、自由でオルタナティブな感性が交差する作品。異なる音楽の文法や質感を自在に行き来しながらも、それらを無理なくひとつの表現へと結びつけ、JINGRANGならではの音楽的な風景を形づくっている。 アルバムタイトルの『EnYu』は「円融」に由来し、異なるものが互いを妨げることなく調和するという意味を持つ。友人に本作を聴かせた際、「これはまだAIには真似できないね」という言葉を受けたという。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4398623 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/_jing_…
articles.translatedTitle: JINGRANG releases first original AL “EnYu”
articles.translatedExcerpt: JINGRANG released their first original album ``EnYu'' on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. This work is a work that combines a rich musical vocabulary that is not bound by genre boundaries with a free and alternative sensibility. While freely moving between different musical grammars and textures, he effortlessly combines them into a single expression, creating a musical landscape unique to JINGRANG. The album title ``EnYu'' comes from ``enyu'' and has the meaning of different things harmonizing without interfering with each other. articles.translatedTitle: “Remi Hirano All About Charm” will be released, including 21 songs.
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that Remi Hirano will release ``Remi Hirano All About Charm'' on Wednesday, December 2nd. Remi Hirano, who was active as a chanson singer, made her record debut in 1970 with the single "Temptation of Bayon" from Nippon Columbia. By 1972, they had released a total of four singles. This time, while organizing Columbia's in-house master tapes in preparation for making CDs of the sound sources from that time, the sound sources of four unreleased songs were newly discovered. One of these songs, ``I'm Calling You,'' which was recorded in 1972, had only the song title written on the tape and the artist's name unknown, but when Hirano listened to it for the first time in about half a century, it was discovered that the lyrics were written by his father, the late French literary scholar and poet Imao Hirano. The relevant lyrics were also found in a collection of poems written by his father that had been left at home. In addition, the unreleased song “Minato no Akari” recorded in 1970 was written by Umao Hirano.

The tour final will be held at Veats Shibuya in Tokyo on March 7th, the 1st anniversary of the start of the tour. GUMMY, which officially launched on March 7, 2026 at Shinjuku Loft in Tokyo, released their 1st EP “GIVE ME GUMMY” in May and their 2nd EP “GIVE ME CHOCOLATE” in September. And they continue to roll with incredible momentum, including selling out the shibuya CYCLONE one-man 2-day show in Tokyo in December. The first action in 2027 that will carry this momentum will be the holding of the tour ``GIVE ME PINEAPPLE'' and the release of the 3rd EP ``GIVE ME PINEAPPLE''. Gummy, chocolate, pineapple...playful...

articles.translatedTitle: Macaroni Pencil releases special video “Fate Search” (OKKAKE ver) created with FC members
articles.translatedExcerpt: Macaroni Pencil has released a special video for their new song "Fate Sagashi" (OKKAKE ver) on their official YouTube channel. The video was recorded at the free event for members of the official fan site "OKKAKE" held on November 4th at the First Gymnasium of Yoyogi National Stadium. The video, which was shot with OKKAKE members gathered around the members, is a special work that was created for this day only by Macaroni Pencils and OKKAKE. In addition, the video also includes footage taken by fans at the venue on the day of the event with their smartphones, showing not only the members on stage, but also the scenery seen from the audience seats, the expressions of the people who were there, and the enthusiasm that enveloped the venue.

My Fender, which had been dormant for 35 years, didn't make any noise, so I happened to read a business article about a company called Deviser, which appealed to me, so I went to a music store and tried it out. The moment you grip the neck, your hand feels like it's being sucked and the sound starts...

articles.translatedTitle: The cause is myself. , released the "Love Reason" performance video. Show off your charm with elegant formation and perfect expression management
articles.translatedExcerpt: The cause is myself. has released a performance video for their new song "Love Reason." "Love Reason" is the title song of the CD single to be released on November 11th, and the music is provided by Vocaloid P/singer-songwriter syudou. The song is expressed in the unique worldview created by Syudou x Genjib, and is a crazy love song full of love. The performance video released today is a bit different from the music video, as it is captured with camera work that directly conveys the passion and three-dimensionality of the dance itself. While the flowing beauty of the formation changes permeates throughout the song, pay attention to the powerful and supple dance that does not break even in the midst of intense developments, as well as the facial expression management that perfectly expresses the worldview of the song, which is a mixture of madness and love. In addition, the costume in this video is made of shiny fabric that seems to be wrapped in surrounding light, and is made of beads of the same color.

The sound was good, but the string tension and tuning were noticeably unstable, so I also replaced the roller string guide and pegs. I also wanted to add a metallic feel to the sound, so I replaced the bridge saddle with a brass one. The appearance is reminiscent of momose's telecaster, and gold parts are used extensively. The neck joint plate, jack, and strap pin have also been replaced, so only the pickup and nut are left in stock lol It's been a while since I've modified it...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Hudson Westbrook released his new album "Made You Look" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This follow-up to their 2025 debut album "Texas Forever" includes a total of 16 songs. This album is a condensation of his life, love, music activities, and feelings for his hometown of Texas, which has seen remarkable growth over the past two and a half years. This album embraces the charm of traditional country while incorporating modern sensibilities and free songwriting. It depicts not only his momentum as a young artist, but also his growth and struggles as a human being. articles.translatedTitle: YOASOBI releases new song “KILLA” from artist discovery and development project “First Time” Literary Club
articles.translatedExcerpt: YOASOBI has decided to release their new song "KILLA" on November 11th (Wednesday). This work is based on a novel born out of the ``Hajimete'' Literary Club, a program launched in 2022 as part of the ``Hajimete'' collaboration project with four Naoki Prize-winning authors, with the aim of discovering and nurturing new writers who will lead the next generation of literary circles. At the same time, the song jacket has also been released. The original novel is ``I Want to Kill Senpai, so I Dress as a Woman'' by Yoa Maeneko, who was a member of the first generation of ``The First Literary Club''. This work, which was released as a book on October 16th (Friday), is Maneko Yoa's debut work. In order to fulfill the wishes of the person he loves, a boy becomes the "ideal beautiful girl." A dangerous yet funny story that depicts the distortions and purity of love through the image of a boy who changes himself for the sake of the person he falls in love with.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Hakubi, a rock band from Kyoto, has announced the release of their venue-only EP ``Daydream'' and that they will be holding a ``Hakubi venue-limited EP ``Daydream'' release tour starting in January 2027. This tour will visit 7 locations across the country to commemorate the release of the EP ``White Day Dream'', which will be sold exclusively at live venues. The EP is scheduled to include three new songs with the theme of "love," which Hakubi has not often written about until now. Expectations are high as this work will show the band a new frontier, something a little different from their previous works. In addition, tickets for this tour will be accepted from 21:00 on November 7th through the fan club ``Yuruhakubi no Sato'' and official tickets with special benefits. Check the official website and official SNS for details. Comment: The colors that suddenly catch my eye, and the colors that disappear when I wake up...

articles.translatedTitle: Hannah Jadagu releases romantic new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Hannah Jadagu released her new single "Curse" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. This work is a work that further develops the musicality explored in the second album "Describe" released in 2025. Boldly incorporating synthesizers and analog sounds, they fuse delicate vocals and fantastic sounds. The happiness of falling in love and the fear of losing that relationship. The result is an alternative pop song that is both romantic and somewhat disturbing, with conflicting emotions intertwined. articles.translatedTitle: Sam Barber releases new EP with 6 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Sam Barber released his new EP “Outlier” on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work, which consists of 6 songs in total, is the latest project following the second studio album "Broken View" released in April. articles.translatedTitle: Macaroni Pencil's special program "TOKYO FM Holiday Special "Now, I love you!"" will be broadcast
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that the special program ``TOKYO FM Holiday Special Macaroni Pencil "Ima, I Love You!"'', in which Macaroni Pencil will be the personality, will be broadcast from 3:00 pm on November 23rd. The title of the program is an impressive phrase from ``Fate Search'', the title song of the latest EP ``Fate Search / Final Night EP''. Based on the concept of "I love you now!", we introduce listeners' thoughts on important people, things, and things they like. It will be a 2-hour special program that will convey the various feelings of thinking about someone, along with Macaroni Pencil's music. The program is also looking for messages from listeners. The theme is “I love you now!” In addition to anecdotes about the people and things she loves, she also writes about the feelings she feels for someone but cannot express in words, such as "I'm too embarrassed to tell them," "I can't be honest," and "I can't reach them anymore."

A winter alley filled with the smell of dinner, the small waving gesture of our joined hands, and the slightly detoured way home, regretting our farewells. The lyrics carefully depict scenes from everyday life, and each song conveys the happiness of spending time with loved ones. When you fall in love, the usual scenery looks a little different, a promise for the future is born from a casual conversation, and even the cold winter can feel sweet just by being with someone - the story uses simple words to express the thrill of love and the honest desire to be together in the future. …
